title: Solution of the Mumford-Shah conjecture
summary: We prove the Mumford--Shah conjecture, formulated in 1989, by completing the classification of blow-up limits of minimizers in the plane. The remaining case concerns limits whose discontinuity set is noncompact and has connected complement. In this setting, we rule out bounded connected components using second-variation inequalities obtained from combined inner and outer variations associated with two perpendicular translations of a compact subset separated from the rest of the discontinuity set.
